privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Your privacy is extremely important to us. This website ('Eat Rice / Ăn Cơm') is committed to protecting your personal data in full compliance with Google AdSense and global privacy guidelines.
privacy.p2: We do not collect personal identifiable information (PII) such as your name, email, or exact location. We only process anonymous voting choices, hashed browser cookies, and LocalStorage tokens strictly for anti-spam verification.
privacy.p3: Third-party vendors, including Google AdSense, may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to our website or other websites on the Internet.
privacy.p4: You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings (https://www.google.com/settings/ads).

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: By using the Eat Rice website, you agree to these simple terms. This platform is designed solely for friendly global daily check-ins.
terms.p2: Users agree not to attempt automated spamming, bot attacks, or manipulating the voting counter.
terms.p3: We reserve the right to reset counters or block malicious traffic to preserve system integrity.
terms.p4: The service is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind.
